'''Asgnats''' were creatures genetically engineered by the [[Lurrian]]s of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lur]]. Swarms of asgnats bored through the world's snowy ravines and glaciers to create the warrenlike [[City/Legends|cities]] that the Lur inhabited.<ref name="EGTD">''[[The Essential Guide to Droids]]''</ref>
